description: Generate and host a privacy policy for a business, app, store or site and return its stable HTTPS URL. Free resource types and Agent API key holders get liveUrl at once; other types get a Stripe Checkout link ($29/year) for a human to pay, plus the pendingUrl that goes live after payment. Repeating a call with the same inputs (or the same idempotencyKey) within 24 hours returns the first result.

companyName.description: Business, app or site name as it should appear in the policy.

companySlug.description: URL slug (a-z, 0-9, hyphens). Defaults to a slug of companyName.

email.description: Owner contact email. Receives the live link and manages the URL later.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own retry key. Defaults to a hash of the other inputs.

resourceType.description: What the policy covers. See list_resource_types for which are free.

name: create_privacy_policy_url
title: Create a hosted privacy policy URL
